products.name: BetterLaunch
products.tagline: Launch your product, get discovered by more people, and earn valuable dofollow backlinks.
products.description:
BetterLaunch is a product launch platform for indie makers and developers to share new products and gain visibility within a community of builders. It organizes submissions into weekly launch rounds and lets users browse what others are shipping.

Featured products include boilerplates, starter kits, and AI tools such as MkSaaS, Mkdirs, and MkExt. A stated benefit of participating is earning dofollow backlinks for discovery and SEO.

products.name: Mkdirs
products.tagline: The best directory boilerplate, packed with AI, Listings, Payment, Submission, CMS, Blog, Authentication, Newsletter, SEO, Themes and more.
products.description:
Mkdirs is an open-source directory boilerplate built on Next.js, Shadcn UI, Tailwind CSS, Auth.js, Sanity CMS, Stripe, Resend, and the Vercel AI SDK. It is aimed at developers and makers who want to launch a directory website quickly, with a stated setup time of about 30 minutes.

Key features include advanced keyword search, filterable and sortable listings, detailed item pages, AI-assisted submission forms, free and paid submissions, sponsored ads, a blog, newsletter subscription, secure authentication with email/password and Google or GitHub login, SEO metadata, sitemaps, dark mode, responsive design, and customizable themes. Content is managed through the built-in Sanity Studio.

products.name: MkSaaS
products.tagline: The complete Next.js boilerplate for building profitable SaaS, packed with AI, auth, payments, i18n, newsletter, dashboard, blog, docs, blocks, themes, SEO and more.
products.description:
MkSaaS is a complete Next.js boilerplate for building AI SaaS products, packaging auth, payments, i18n, newsletter, dashboard, blog, docs, blocks, themes and SEO into a production-ready foundation. It targets developers and indie makers who want to launch a SaaS without wiring vendors, and is designed to work with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and Windsurf.

  • Revenue stack: Stripe, Creem or Waffo checkout, subscriptions, one-time payments, webhooks and invoices
  • AI product base: AI SDK integrations with text, image and chat demos
  • Growth and dashboard: landing, pricing, blog, docs, legal pages, sitemap, metadata and OG setup, plus user settings, billing, API keys and admin management

products.name: TanStarter
products.tagline: TanStarter is the TanStack Start boilerplate for AI SaaS with auth, payments, database, storage, email, blog, SEO & more, deployed on Cloudflare Workers.
products.description:
TanStarter is a TanStack Start boilerplate for building SaaS products, deployed on Cloudflare Workers. It is aimed at developers and indie makers who want a production-ready foundation for AI-powered SaaS applications rather than starting from scratch.

It includes authentication, payments via Stripe, Creem, or Waffo, a Cloudflare D1 database, R2 storage, email and newsletter integrations, a blog, dashboard, admin pages, and AI examples covering text, chat, image generation, image editing, and text-to-speech. A CLI provisions Cloudflare resources and deploys the project.

  • Built with TanStack Start, Cloudflare Workers, Drizzle ORM, and BetterAuth
  • Includes marketing pages, SEO metadata, sitemap, and OG image generation
  • Structured for use with AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot

products.name: OpenFree
products.tagline: Discover curated free and open source AI tools for indie makers.
products.description:
OpenFree is a curated directory of free and open source AI tools aimed at indie makers. It organizes listings by category, such as agent frameworks, coding agents, language models, chat interfaces, and MCP servers, and lets users search and sort tools, including by GitHub stars.

Listings summarize each tool's purpose, license or pricing status, and repository. Examples include OpenClaw, an open-source personal assistant; n8n, a workflow automation platform; ollama, for running open models locally; Whisper, a speech recognition model; and PaddleOCR, an OCR toolkit.

products.name: 海棠诗社
products.tagline: 海棠诗社，古诗词的数字桃源。海棠诗社按诗集、朝代、诗人、诗词、类型等方式检索，内容丰富，信息齐全。海棠诗社按选集、主题、节日、节气、词牌、时令、地理等方式精选分类，支持诗词收藏。海棠诗社全站响应式布局，兼容移动端，支持暗黑模式，响应速度快。
products.description:
海棠诗社是一个中国古诗词数字阅读平台，收录历代诗词作品及诗人信息。用户可按诗集、朝代、诗人、诗词或类型检索内容，也可通过选集、主题、节日、节气、词牌、时令、地理等分类方式浏览精选诗词。

平台提供每日一诗与精选诗句推荐，支持诗词收藏。全站采用响应式布局，兼容移动端，支持暗黑模式，页面响应速度快。

products.name: MkDollar
products.tagline: Discover practical resources, tools, deals, backlinks, rankings, and AI updates that help indie makers find opportunities and make their first dollar online.
products.description:
MkDollar is an all-in-one platform for indie makers seeking their first online revenue. It gathers free tools, tutorials, and resources for finding opportunities and building products.

The site offers seven free tools, including Indie Tools for browsing curated tools by category, a DR Leaderboard for tracking domain rating growth, and directories for product-submission backlinks. Creative generators cover logos, favicons, Open Graph images, and videos from text. It also hosts 29 video tutorials and a blog covering SaaS templates, infrastructure, AI coding, and indie growth, plus open-source templates, AI SaaS starters, and indie software products.

products.name: MkAgent
products.tagline: MkAgent is a local-first, Pi-powered AI agent workspace for Desktop, WebUI, and CLI.
products.description:
MkAgent is an open-source, local-first AI agent workspace built on the Pi agent runtime, available as an Electron desktop app, WebUI, and CLI. It is intended for anyone who wants more control over their AI work and for builders who want to fork a working agent product into their own branded desktop application. The three clients share one authenticated WebSocket RPC protocol, session history, Skills, permissions, and local files, so a session can be resumed across surfaces.

  • Point it at a real working directory; sessions, Skills, permissions, and views stay scoped to that workspace.
  • Connect models through Pi using ChatGPT Plus or Claude Pro/Max subscriptions, provider API keys, compatible endpoints, or local Ollama models.
  • Sessions stream thinking, tool calls, diffs, plans, and artifacts; workspaces, sessions, and Skills live locally.

products.name: MkExt
products.tagline: MkExt is an open-source browser extension starter for SaaS applications. Build a polished browser extension with React surfaces, shared state, localization, and Chrome and Firefox packaging.
products.description:
MkExt is an open-source browser extension starter for SaaS applications, built on the WXT framework and licensed under Apache 2.0. It provides ready-made surfaces—popup, side panel, options, new tab, DevTools, and background pages—so developers can shape an extension around an existing product rather than starting from a blank manifest.

  • Builds Chrome MV3 and Firefox packages from one React codebase
  • Includes authentication flow, typed shared state across extension contexts, localization, and themes
  • Connects to SaaS backends such as Better Auth via a configurable auth URL
